text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to finalize SKU/pricing bundles for AWS/GCP/Azure listings by EOW. Legal needs the billing mapping + short allowed-usage blurb. Who can pick this up?

ajay: I can pull the SKU export and line up bundle candidates. do we keep the current small/medium/large grouping or switch to vCPU-based tiers?

tom: Azure has packaging constraints — must reference a single image per offer. That can complicate size variety unless we use VM sizes under one offer. cc @leigh

leigh: Legal note: we need to confirm whether we're offering metered usage (per-token/GB) or fixed subscription in each marketplace. Also need the customer data flow summary (one paragraph) for compliance check.

marketplace-bot: Created task partners-board#452 for "cloud catalog: pricing & SKU bundle mapping" — https://trello.example/452

ajay: Pasting current rough mapping (will refine):
```
sku-small -> 2 vCPU, 4GB RAM, metered tokens
sku-medium -> 4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, metered tokens + volume discount
sku-large -> 8 vCPU, 32GB RAM, committed monthly
```
This means for AWS/GCP we can keep 3 SKUs. Azure will need 1 offer + 3 VM size options.

maria: Good. Leigh — if metered is a blocker for Azure marketplace, we can present fixed subscription for that platform only at launch. Is that acceptable?

leigh: Prefer uniform billing, but okay to stagger launches. Need sign-off from finance on pricing parity. Also send the short data-flow paragraph — I can attach to legal checklist.

ajay: I will draft: "Customer requests go to Redwood-hosted inference. Only token metadata (no raw customer content) is logged for billing. Model weights and customer data remain in customer tenancy for private deployments." Thoughts?

tom: sounds fine but "no raw customer content" may be too strong for hosted. Maybe: "we only log token-level metadata for billing; customers can opt out of data logging on Private/Dedicated plans."

leigh: Acceptable. Add a line about encryption at rest/in transit and KMS usage for private offers.

ajay: Updated snippet:
```
Data flow: requests directed to Redwood inference endpoints. Token-level metadata logged for billing; customers can opt-out on Private/Dedicated. All traffic TLS encrypted; keys managed via KMS for Private deployments.
```

maria: Nice. Next — assets/marketing copy: who owns the 1-line product blurb for each SKU? We should keep descriptions short for marketplace UI (60 chars).

ajay: I can write 3 one-liners and drop in /assets/marketplace.

maria: Great. Action items: ajay = finalize SKU CSV + 3 one-liners by Thu COB; tom = confirm Azure offer structure + AMI constraints by Wed; leigh = legal checklist entries + T&C snippet by Thu AM; I'll coordinate with finance for parity.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: onboarding doc template uploaded to /drive/marketplace/onboarding-template.md

maria: Thanks team — will sync again after Thurs updates. :thumbsup:
